primary_matrix: 36 rows, 3 seeds, full original datasets and 1000 queries, native RaBitQ pruning/HACC
profiling_recovery: Initial auxiliary profile used a copied CMake cache with the old source path. Cache was preserved under a new name, and a fresh separately instrumented stage build completed all 12 profiles.
independent_high_bit_repetition: 3 TieredQ points, seed 0, full 1000 queries; source snapshot supplied
full_score_diagnostic: 3 separate RaBitQ points, native extra-bit pruning disabled, HACC retained
normal_fast_recall_parity: Matched at all 3 full-data 8-bit seed-0 points
limitations: Three seeds do not establish statistical significance, especially for SIFT.
Nominal budgets are not exact equal-memory comparisons.
Primary timing measures 8 threads/batch 32, not single-query latency.
Precision-preserving fast mode is slower than the previous int8 approximation.
Public TieredQ API remains inner-product search; the L2 adapter is in the benchmark harness.
